data.one_liner: Displays an animated top or bottom alert banner with optional icon, action, and customization.
data.what_it_does: Shows a temporary alert banner that slides in from the top or bottom of the screen. The banner can display different types (info, success, warning, error) with corresponding icons and colors, and supports custom icons, actions, and theming.
use_when: You need a lightweight, customizable replacement for SnackBar.
You want an animated banner that can appear from top or bottom with optional action button.
avoid_when: You require persistent or background notifications.
You need complex dialog interactions or multi‑step flows.
strengths: Simple API with a single static call.
Supports custom icons, colors, and action callbacks.
weaknesses: Only one alert at a time; no built‑in queue.
Limited to brief messages; not suitable for rich content.

alternatives.name: another_flushbar
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar top/bottom alert banners with more extensive customization and queue handling.

alternatives.name: overlay_support
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a broader set of overlay widgets including toasts and notifications.

data.minimal_example: AlertInfo.show(context: context, text: 'Message to be displayed', typeInfo: TypeInfo.success, position: MessagePosition.bottom, action: 'Undo', actionCallback: () { /* handle */ });
